mapper.sql: id, name, duration_months AS durationMonths, bonus_months AS bonusMonths, traffic_bytes AS trafficBytes, bonus_traffic_bytes AS bonusTrafficBytes, price, price_per_month AS pricePerMonth, price_per_gb AS pricePerGb, description, status, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xray_packet ORDER BY sort_order ASC, duration_months ASC
SELECT FROM xray_packet WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, duration_months ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xray_packet (name, duration_months, bonus_months, traffic_bytes, bonus_traffic_bytes, price, price_per_month, price_per_gb, description, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{durationMonths}, #{bonusMonths}, #{trafficBytes}, #{bonusTrafficBytes}, #{price}, #{pricePerMonth}, #{pricePerGb}, #{description}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE xray_packet SET name = #{name}, duration_months = #{durationMonths}, bonus_months = #{bonusMonths}, traffic_bytes = #{trafficBytes}, bonus_traffic_bytes = #{bonusTrafficBytes}, price = #{price}, price_per_month = #{pricePerMonth}, price_per_gb = #{pricePerGb}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
